critical_code_review_comments: shared/admin/category_requests.py L262/L297 — notify() is inside the same session but wrapped only by the outer commit; if inapp_notify raises, the approve/reject will roll back. Per notifications module doc-comment ('notifications never fail the parent transaction'), the notify helper should swallow exceptions internally — verify that guarantee holds; otherwise wrap the notify() call site in try/except.

shared/suppliers/portal_routes.py L582 resubmit_product_request — good: 409 on non-rejected, clears reviewer metadata. Consider also clearing created_master_product_id defensively (not applicable to rejected today, but if flow evolves it prevents stale linkage).
PortalProductRequests.jsx L73-79 — good fix from prev iter: 'New request' button now disabled until categories load (categories.length===0). Race condition from iteration_36 is resolved.
PortalProductRequests.jsx L211 RequestForm — when isRevising, the form does not disable the submit button if the user hasn't changed anything; a no-op PATCH will still fire. Minor UX only.

shared/admin/category_requests.py — supplier_router uses `partner_id` column as nullable via migration 0019 but there is no unique/xor CHECK ensuring exactly one of partner_id/supplier_id is populated. Consider a DB CHECK: (partner_id IS NULL) <> (supplier_id IS NULL).
